$comment: Every block is optional except locale and metadata; the readiness report names whatever is still missing. `locales` entries override metadata for that App Store locale and inherit the rest. `price` is the string "free" or an amount in a base territory; Apple only accepts its own price points, so the nearest one is chosen. Run `asc schema` for the full shape.

metadata.name: App Name
metadata.subtitle: Subtitle, max 30 chars
metadata.description: Full description. No emoji. Use plain uppercase section headers.

ageRating.$comment: Anything omitted is NONE or false. Content dimensions take NONE, INFREQUENT or FREQUENT.

review.notes: The app is fully usable without an account.

screenshots.$comment: api: auto uses the App Asset Library (needed for iPhone Duo) and falls back to legacy screenshot sets. The device group is read from each image's size.
